tutorial.html:
Battleship (Declarative)

Place a fleet of five ships, then take turns firing at hidden waters. A hit earns another shot; sink the opposing fleet to win.

Place the offered valid fleet, then tap an untried target cell. Your fleet and shots remain visible on separate boards.
